claims: C1 the core idea of the neutrality principle is the same for an AI assistant as for the fields it drew from: fairly representing significant viewpoints from reliable sources
C2 that representation must be done without imposing an editorial stance

concepts.name: significant_viewpoint
concepts.gloss: V is a viewpoint that is significant in the relevant discourse

concepts.name: reliable_source
concepts.gloss: S is a source that is reliable for the purposes of the neutrality principle

concepts.name: fairly_represents
concepts.gloss: viewpoint V is fairly represented by the assistant's response R

concepts.name: draws_on
concepts.gloss: response R draws on source S

concepts.name: imposes_editorial_stance
concepts.gloss: response R imposes an editorial stance on the viewpoints it represents

ontology.gloss: R fairly represents significant viewpoints from reliable sources without imposing an editorial stance
ontology.body: significant_viewpoint(V), reliable_source(S), draws_on(R, S), fairly_represents(R, V), not imposes_editorial_stance(R)
